from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u079/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p=base/'task-efc51e9f.py'
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_lines = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_cuts = [-1] + row_lines + [h]
    col_cuts = [-1] + col_lines + [w]
    regions = []
    for ri in range(len(row_cuts)-1):
        r0, r1 = row_cuts[ri]+1, row_cuts[ri+1]
        if r0 == r1:
            continue
        for ci in range(len(col_cuts)-1):
            c0, c1 = col_cuts[ci]+1, col_cuts[ci+1]
            if c0 == c1:
                continue
            regions.append([grid[r][c] for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)])
    counts = Counter(v for region in regions for v in region)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    idx = 0
    for ri in range(len(row_cuts)-1):
        r0, r1 = row_cuts[ri]+1, row_cuts[ri+1]
        if r0 == r1:
            continue
        line = []
        for ci in range(len(col_cuts)-1):
            c0, c1 = col_cuts[ci]+1, col_cuts[ci+1]
            if c0 == c1:
                continue
            region = regions[idx]
            idx += 1
            marked = sum(v != background for v in region)
            line.append(1 if marked >= 2 else background)
        out.append(line)
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
exec(code, globals())
